Also eliminated teams' ability to protect two home games from being played abroad. Could go to 11 with NFLPA approval. Japan mentioned as future frontier.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark to serve as grand marshal of Indianapolis 500
story_log.development: Fever guard Clark will be grand marshal of Indy 500 this Sunday during six-day break in Fever schedule. Iconic race, iconic rookie in Year 3.

story_log.title: James Wood hits inside-the-park grand slam for Nationals
story_log.development: Wood hit inside-the-park grand slam as Nationals beat Mets 9-6. Center fielder completely botched the play. Rare and absurd moment.

story_log.title: Ketel Marte walk-off homer with two outs in ninth gives Diamondbacks comeback win
story_log.development: Marte hit walk-off homer with Arizona down to last out against Giants. Dodgers also rallied late to beat Padres 5-4 and reclaim first place in NL West.

story_log.title: NCAA takes big step toward adding flag football as championship sport by 2028
story_log.development: NCAA moving toward formal approval of flag football as championship sport by 2028. Expected to be approved by all three divisions in 2027.

story_log.title: Bills WR Keon Coleman says this is a 'make or break' year for him
story_log.development: Coleman told media 2026 is 'make or break year' for him after disappointing rookie season. Entering Year 2 with high expectations in Buffalo.

story_log.title: Victor Wembanyama's 41-24-3b legendary Game 1 in double OT WCF
story_log.development: Wemby put on all-time legendary performance in Game 1 double-OT thriller: 41 points, 24 rebounds, 3 blocks, 14-25 FG. Hit logo 3-pointer to tie game in OT. Youngest player ever with 40-20 playoff game. Spurs stunned Thunder 122-115 in double OT to take 1-0 series lead. Dylan Harper had 24-11-6-7 steals (first 20/10/5/5 CF game since Bird), Alex Caruso 31 points off bench (most off bench in CF since 2020).

story_log.title: Canadiens advance to Conference Finals after Game 7 OT win over Sabres
story_log.development: Montreal advanced to Eastern Conference Finals with 3-2 OT win in Game 7 at Buffalo. Alex Newhook scored game-winner in OT (his 2nd Game 7 OT goal this postseason). Sabres eliminated after epic series. Canadiens reach ECF for first time since 2021.

story_log.title: J.T. Ginn loses no-hitter and game in span of 4 pitches
story_log.development: A's pitcher J.T. Ginn took no-hitter into 9th inning vs Angels with game still 0-0. Adam Frazier broke it up with single with zero outs, then Zach Neto hit walk-off homer four pitches later. Angels won 2-1. MLB still hasn't seen no-hitter since 2024 season.

story_log.title: Aaron Rodgers officially signs 1-year, $25M deal with Steelers
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Rodgers officially signed one-year contract worth up to $25M with Pittsburgh. Appeared at OTAs at 7am before first practice. Will be backup to Will Howard in 22nd NFL season. McCarthy gave Howard extended look before Rodgers returned.

story_log.title: NFL expected to award 2028 Draft to Minneapolis, Super Bowl LXIV to Nashville
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: NFL owners expected to vote Tuesday at Spring League Meeting to award 2028 Draft to Minneapolis and Super Bowl LXIV (February 2030) to Nashville. Nashville would be first Super Bowl for Music City.

story_log.title: Pelicans hire Jamahl Mosley as new head coach on 5-year deal
story_log.development: New Orleans hired Jamahl Mosley on five-year contract after he was dismissed by Magic on May 4. Mosley led Magic to three consecutive playoff berths and built elite defenses (No. 3 in '23-24, No. 2 in '24-25). Pelicans see parallels to Magic rebuild.

story_log.title: Pep Guardiola to leave Manchester City at season's end after 10 years
story_log.development: Guardiola will leave City at end of season after 10 years, 16 major trophies including Saturday's FA Cup final win. Enzo Maresca expected successor. End of an era for Premier League dynasty.

story_log.title: Jeff Bezos heavy favorite to buy Seattle Seahawks
story_log.development: Bezos is heavy Polymarket favorite to buy Seahawks. His $259B net worth is higher than top five NFL owners combined (Walton, Hunt, Tepper, Kroenke, Jones). Would reset NFL ownership wealth dynamics.

story_log.title: Texas Tech QB Brendan Sorsby files injunction vs NCAA seeking 2026 eligibility
story_log.development: Sorsby, who took indefinite hiatus in April to seek treatment for gambling addiction, filed injunction Monday seeking college eligibility for 2026 season. NFL set supplemental draft deadline for June 22. Sorsby must decide between college and pros.

story_log.title: Colby Covington retires from UFC after career as top welterweight contender
story_log.development: Former interim welterweight champion Covington notified UFC of intent to retire. Challenged for world title three times. End of controversial, successful UFC career.

story_log.title: Neymar makes Brazil's 26-man World Cup roster despite injury concerns
story_log.development: Former Barca and PSG superstar Neymar made Carlo Ancelotti's 26-man Brazil World Cup squad. Chelsea's Joao Pedro missed out. Big story was whether Neymar's fitness would hold up for roster inclusion.

story_log.title: Conor McGregor return against Max Holloway previewed for UFC 329 July 11
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: CBS Sports and media previewing McGregor-Holloway rematch (original fight in 2013). McGregor's first fight in 5 years at 170 lbs. Jorge Masvidal predicts 'Max smokes him like a brisket.' Would cap incredible summer for UFC.

story_log.title: NFL may vote to add two more international games, change scheduling policy
story_log.development: NFL might change key scheduling policy for international games and vote to add two more matchups per reports. League expanding global footprint aggressively.

story_log.title: Colt Emerson's first MLB hit is a three-run homer for Mariners
story_log.development: League's No. 6 overall prospect Emerson (who got $95M extension from Seattle in March) hit three-run homer for his first career MLB hit. Moment for one of baseball's top young talents.

story_log.title: Cavs blow out Pistons in Game 7, advance to Eastern Conference Finals vs Knicks
story_log.development: Cleveland won Game 7 in Detroit 125-94, ending Pistons' season. Donovan Mitchell had 26-7-8-0 TOV, Jarrett Allen 23-7, Sam Merrill 23 off bench. Cade and Duren combined for 20 points in elimination game. Cavs reach ECF for first time since 2018, face Knicks starting Tuesday.

story_log.title: Aaron Rai becomes first English player to win PGA Championship in 107 years
story_log.development: Rai won his first major at Aronimink, closing with incredible approach from 68 feet and steady putting. First player from England to win PGA since 1919. Wore two gloves (childhood habit from cold English weather) and iron covers (tribute to working-class father who cleaned clubs with pin and baby oil). Jim Nantz called it with Rocky reference.

story_log.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander wins second consecutive NBA MVP
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Full voting results released Sunday night. SGA becomes 14th player ever to win back-to-back MVPs, first guard since Curry (2014-16). Averaged 30+ pts on 55% shooting, never scored below 20 all season. Luka received 0 first-place votes despite leading NBA in scoring. Blake Griffin roasted Shams for spoiling it on a Sunday.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark sets WNBA record with third career 20-10 game
story_log.development: Clark had 21-7-10-2b in Fever win over Storm. Now has three 20-point/10-assist games in her career — more than any player in WNBA history. Fever are 2-0 to start season. Clark becoming the face of the league in Year 3.

story_log.title: Nashville expected to be awarded Super Bowl LXIV in 2030
story_log.development: NFL owners will vote Tuesday at Spring League Meeting to award Super Bowl LXIV (February 2030) to Nashville. Would be first Super Bowl for Music City, showcase for Titans' new stadium.

story_log.title: Edgar Quero walk-off homer gives White Sox series win over Cubs
story_log.development: Quero hit walk-off homer in extras to give Sox series win over Cubs in crosstown rivalry. Pete Crow-Armstrong exchanged words with White Sox fan at her engagement party. Cubs bullpen blew late lead. Chicago baseball drama at its finest.

story_log.title: Phillies climb back above .500 after atrocious start to season
story_log.development: Philadelphia swept Pirates to move above .500 for first time this season. Have won 15 of last 19 games. Remarkable turnaround from brutal April.

story_log.title: Mets walk off Yankees 7-6 to take Subway Series
story_log.development: Tyrone Taylor 3-run homer in 9th with Mets down to last out tied it. Mets won in extras to take series. Brandon Nimmo robbed HR in front of Astros fans then gave them a ball. Yankees struggling.

story_log.title: Roki Sasaki throws first 7-inning start in MLB career
story_log.development: Sasaki went 7 IP, 4 H, 1 ER, 0 BB, 8 SO vs Angels in Dodgers' 10-1 win. First time he's completed 7 innings in the majors. Dodgers sweep Halos in Freeway Series.

story_log.title: James Franklin on coaching at Virginia Tech: 'I've got a chip on my shoulder'
story_log.development: Franklin gave commencement speech at Miami University, discussed getting fired by Penn State and turning down $40M buyout to immediately return to coaching. Says he's in 'win-now mode' at Virginia Tech. First public comments on Penn State departure and Virginia Tech hire.

story_log.title: Chelsea Gray hits game-winner with 0.7 left, Aces beat Dream 85-84
story_log.development: Gray made clutch bucket with 0.7 seconds left, then stole inbound to seal win. Becky Hammon: 'The bigger the moment, the bigger she gets.' Gray proving she's still the most clutch player in the WNBA.

story_log.title: Giants bring back thrusting celebration despite ban
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 6]: Giants refuse to acknowledge their thrusting ban. Players went back to the explicit celebration after briefly doing polite bows. Beat Athletics 10-1. Harrison Bader hit grand slam in 8-run inning.

story_log.title: Conor McGregor return against Max Holloway set for UFC 329 on July 11
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: CBS Sports previewing McGregor-Holloway rematch (original fight in 2013). McGregor's first fight in 5 years at 170 lbs. Would cap incredible summer for UFC with White House event and stacked Vegas card.

story_log.title: Bill Belichick on Pardon My Take for Grit Week 2026
story_log.development: PMT drops interview with Bill Belichick to kick off Grit Week 2026. PFT says interview lasted 'about an hour and a half' and 'could have talked to him forever.' Big Cat called it 'incredible show.' PMT finally landed their white whale.

story_log.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander wins second consecutive NBA MVP
story_log.development: Shams Charania broke news that SGA won his second consecutive MVP award, joining 13 other players in league history to win back-to-back. First guard to do so since Curry in 2014-16.

story_log.title: 42-year-old Aaron Rodgers returns to Steelers on one-year, $25M deal
story_log.development: Schefter reported Rodgers and Steelers agreed to terms on one-year deal worth up to $25M. Reunites with Mike McCarthy for 22nd NFL season. Expected at OTAs Monday.

story_log.title: Sabres erase 3-1 deficit, force Game 7 in Montreal with 8-3 blowout
story_log.development: Buffalo dominated Game 6 in Montreal 8-3 to tie series 3-3. Rasmus Dahlin had 5 points (first defenseman in Sabres history with 5 pts in playoff game). Jack Quinn scored twice. Series returns to Buffalo for Game 7 Monday.

story_log.title: Conor McGregor announces return to UFC against Max Holloway on July 11
story_log.development: Dana White announced McGregor will fight Max Holloway at UFC 329 in Las Vegas on July 11 at 170 lbs. McGregor's first fight since 2021, rematch of 2013 bout McGregor won by UD.

story_log.title: Ronda Rousey submits Gina Carano in 17 seconds on Netflix MMA card
story_log.development: Rousey submitted Carano in just 17 seconds in their long-awaited fight on Netflix. SharpFootball tweeted the broadcast literally leaked Rousey's game plan and the fight ended in 17 seconds.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani gets little-league home run after controversial ground-rule double ruling
story_log.development: Ohtani hit line drive that appeared to go over wall but was ruled in play. He ran around bases for inside-the-park homer. Umpires reviewed and kept it in play, gifting him a little-league homer.

story_log.title: Dodgers demolish Angels 15-2 as Alek Manoah implodes
story_log.development: Dodgers crushed Angels 15-2. Manoah's final line: 1.1 IP, 6 H, 8 ER, 3 BB, 59 pitches. Jose Soriano also struggled: 5.1 IP, 6 ER, 6 BB.

story_log.title: Texas Tech softball pulls off impossible comeback: down 8-0 with one out left, wins 10-9
story_log.development: Texas Tech was down 8-0 with only one out remaining in NCAA tournament game. Hit grand slam to tie it, then won 10-9 in extras. Teams were 0-640 this century when trailing by 8+ runs in tourney.

story_log.title: NBA accidentally runs Cavs-Knicks ECF promo before Cavs-Pistons Game 7
story_log.development: ABC ran a Cavaliers vs Knicks Eastern Conference Finals ad this morning while Cavs are still playing Pistons in second round Game 7. Internet jokes about 'scriptwriters' leaking the result.

story_log.title: Julio Rodríguez robs home run with epic leaping grab
story_log.development: Julio made spectacular leaping catch at wall to rob homer vs Padres. Mariners lost 7-4 but Julio put on a show.

story_log.title: Rodolfo Durán gets first career hit and homer after 11 years in minors
story_log.development: Durán spent 11 years in minor leagues before recording his first MLB hit, which was a home run. Emotional moment.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber reaches 20 homers before Fernando Tatis Jr. hits ONE
story_log.development: Schwarber became first player to 20 homers this season. Tatis still has zero. Schwarber can't explain why he's on this tear. Internet notices the absurdity.

story_log.title: Golden Knights stripped of 2nd-round pick, Tortorella fined $100k for media violations
story_log.development: NHL stripped Vegas of second-round pick and fined coach John Tortorella $100k for 'flagrant violations' of Stanley Cup playoff media regulations. Unprecedented penalty.

story_log.title: Charles Woodson Jr. commits to Michigan, following father's legendary footsteps
story_log.development: Four-star DB Charles Woodson Jr. committed to Michigan, same school where his father won Heisman Trophy. Like father, like son.

story_log.title: Suspect arrested in shooting of Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy
story_log.development: 20-year-old man arrested in connection with shooting of Missouri star Ahmad Hardy at outdoor concert in Mississippi. Hardy remains in stable condition.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson becomes first player in WNBA history with multiple 45-point games
story_log.development: Wilson dropped 45+ points for second time in career, only player in WNBA history to do it multiple times. Aces beat Sun.

story_log.title: Mason Miller pitching like the best closer in baseball
story_log.development: Miller threw 34-pitch, 4-out save with 4 strikeouts. Now has 21 IP, 0.86 ERA, 44 SO, 14 SV, leads all relievers in K/9 (18.86). A's have an absolute weapon.

story_log.title: Wolves traded more picks for Rudy Gobert than he scored in Games 5 and 6 combined
story_log.development: StatMuse tweet roasting Gobert: Wolves gave up more draft picks for him than his combined point total in final two games of series. Gobert had 0 points in Game 6.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle becomes youngest player ever with 30-10-5-5 playoff game
story_log.development: Castle at 21 became youngest player in NBA history with 30+ pts, 10+ reb, 5+ ast, 5+ threes in a playoff game. Historic performance to close out Wolves.

story_log.title: Wemby on facing OKC: 'I'm thinking about getting this press conference over with'
story_log.development: Wemby postgame when asked about facing Thunder: 'Right now I'm not even thinking about it. I'm thinking about recovering. I'm thinking about getting this press conference over with.' Internet loves the exhausted honesty.

story_log.title: Canadiens can close out Sabres in Game 6 at home
story_log.development: Montreal leads series 3-2, can advance to Conference Finals at home tonight. Cole Caufield has 21 goals in 23 Saturday games this season including playoffs, leads NHL.

story_log.development: Flagg dating Arianna Robertson (sister of Andre Roberson, also at Duke). Internet already projecting their future kids as basketball prospects: 'Their kids will be 6'1 by 3rd grade.' Wholesome, absurd, very internet.
